'''Sirdar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a remote region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point, a small population of the insectivorous [[winged xendrite]]s was placed on Sirdar to help with insect control. The xendrites reproduced at an astounding rate and soon overran the planet.<ref name= "CG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
